column3: Direct parallel: angelic reinforcement is a numbered, successive addition responding to need.
The sufficient custodian frame supports reliance on the giver behind the reinforcement.
Shows imdad as added collective capacity, while preventing it from proving final favor by itself.
Immediate continuation: the same battlefield reinforcement expands to five thousand under stated conditions.
Sets the battle deployment in which the address to the believers is situated.
Treats provision as supplied by its giver, supporting dependence rather than self-sufficiency.
Adds the Rabb-to-believers pattern, but its healing and guidance are not battlefield reinforcement.

Locates good with Allah, a broad source attribution rather than the specific angelic support.
